description: The investigators reconnoiter the path leading deeper, rolling to discover the cave entrance, making final preparations to throw the Talisman into the lake.

conversation.speaker: player7
conversation.text: #Holding the medal tightly, staring intently at it, and speaking with his mouth: "Hmm... I can't take my eyes off it..."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Whispering to player4 "Is there any way to knock him out for a little while?"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "No need, right?"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Don't you think, if we take this thing to the collector"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Forget all that"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "You lost your gun, can you beat the collector?"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "His informants are all dead now"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "The Turks did it, his men were incompetent."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Any evidence?"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "We have the medal, he has to believe it."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "I don't think he's someone easy to talk to."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "The premise is he can't just snatch it."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "You're right, he could also just treat us like a stray dog on the roadside, kick us to death and take the medal."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "That's why we can't carry it on us."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "A bit humorous"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: (Without Xiao Tang, we should just be cautious.)

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Alright then, we can go directly to the cave to take a look."

conversation.speaker: player7
conversation.text: "Then let's just go." #Staring at the medal

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Let's go, then please lead the way."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "If you really can't, can't you put it in your clothes?"

conversation.speaker: player7
conversation.text: "No, I'm hard-controlled." #Staring at the medal, shaking head.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: The four walk out of the villa. The Bora wind violently sweeps across the land. player4, player5, and Bolan struggle to steady themselves in the gale. Only Johnson stands unaffected, as if a calm, windless area surrounds him.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Keep up!

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "We seem to have found the origin of the wind."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: The last ray of the setting sun is about to sink below the horizon. Dusk envelops the street like a thin veil. The north wind howls, carrying sand and dust. Johnson clearly hears a tearing wail mixed within the wind. The sound doesn't seem to come from a human or animal, carrying an ancient sorrow, piercing Johnson's eardrums like an ice pick and echoing within his skull. (.sc 1/1d6)

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Eh... another sanity check? I understand, everyone's watching.

conversation.speaker: player7
conversation.text: "What did you say?"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: The wailing sound from the north seems to transform into an invisible pull, causing Johnson's feet to uncontrollably turn northward.

conversation.speaker: player7
conversation.text: #Pricking up ears to listen.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Just wailing, no language

conversation.speaker: player7
conversation.text: "Ah, damn my foot" #Tensing muscles and pulling back hard

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Don't worry, follow the direction of the guidance"

conversation.speaker: player7
conversation.text: "It seems like a monster is calling me over there, be careful" #Shouting

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "What we're looking for is the monster"

conversation.speaker: player7
conversation.text: #That is not affected by the wind, so Johnson directly runs to his companion's side, seeing if his companions can benefit from this effect.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Cannot benefit

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Postumia Cave"

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Check if this place is on the map"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: The map of Trieste does not have this place

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Ask the locals for directions"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Raising hands in surrender

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: You walk out of this decaying street and onto a relatively bustling street

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "This, what do we do"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: (taxi! taxi!)

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: A yellow taxi suddenly screeches to a halt by the roadside. A stubble-faced driver rolls down the window and shouts: Where to?

conversation.speaker: player7
conversation.text: "Alright alright"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #gogogo

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: The taxi arrives at the train station in the night. The square in front of the station at seven o'clock is lit by dim yellow lights. The electronic schedule board flashes with departure information. Late-returning travelers drag their suitcases hurriedly through the cold wind.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Pays the money

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: You pay the money

conversation.speaker: player7
conversation.text: #Opens eyes, yawns, gets out of the car holding the medal.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Johnson pushes the car door open and steps into the station square. The violent Bora wind swirls with scraps of paper and sand grains, but the hem of his clothes remains perfectly still. The medal in his arms glows with a steady faint light under the station lights. The other three, having just gotten out of the car, are staggered by the strong wind and have to shield their faces from the blowing dust and sand.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Such an awesome medal"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Bro, let me touch the medal"

conversation.speaker: player7
conversation.text: "Unfortunately, this glory is mine alone to enjoy" #Seeing this scene, Johnson can't help but recite a line from some movie he can't quite place.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "I'm freezing my ass off"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: You enter the station. The people inside the train station seem busy with their own affairs, but their gazes envelop the four like an invisible spiderweb, especially Johnson who is tightly clutching the medal. The waiting hall is filled with a tacitly understood tension.

conversation.speaker: player7
conversation.text: "No way, this thing is warm" #Pouting, turning head and back away

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Remaining vigilant of the surroundings

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Buy tickets, board the train

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "You put it in his pocket"

conversation.speaker: player7
conversation.text: #Lead the way to the ticket office and find the staff, "Hello, I'd like a ticket to Postumia, departing now."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: The clerk behind the ticket window silently hands out four tickets to the Postumia Caves.

conversation.speaker: player7
conversation.text: #Pull out two fingers, struggling to pinch my own ticket.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: The locals in the waiting area lower their heads to adjust their collars, Turkish tourists adjust their camera lenses, but no one takes a step closer.

conversation.speaker: player7
conversation.text: #While waiting, squat on the ground, bury my head staring at the medal, trying to look less conspicuous.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Your train has arrived.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: #Board the train, and cautiously observe the surroundings and stay with companions, prepare for combat.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Let's board.

conversation.speaker: player7
conversation.text: #Stand up and closely follow everyone onto the train.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: An oppressive silence fills the train carriage. Passengers each stare down at books or out the window, but the investigators can clearly feel hidden gazes from different directions.

conversation.speaker: player7
conversation.text: #Feeling somewhat restless, actively shift closer to the window seat.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Maybe we should get off? Can't do much with the whole city watching us."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Three hours later, the train arrives. Passengers silently crowd around the four as they disembark. In the distant darkness stands an even deeper, massive circular silhouette—the cave entrance they seek, like a black hole devouring light in the night.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Johnson, can you feel the call now?"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Johnson feels the call coming from due north.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #To the cave, let's go!

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "What's done is done, let's go."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Hmm, due north is not the location of the cave.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Follow the guidance, go straight.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Let's go, let's go.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: The cave entrance is blocked by a heavy metal door. The door surface is covered in rivets, and a huge lock is deeply embedded in the rock, clearly specially reinforced and difficult to open.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Oh, great."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Clanging sounds of fighting come from inside.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: (Seems like a bit too much?

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Listen carefully.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: The clashing sound of metal weapons comes from behind the door, mixed with angry shouts in Turkish and Italian. Chaotic footsteps echo in the cave, clearly indicating intense conflict inside.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: .st show Stealth

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: <player3>'s currently registered personal information is as follows:

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "What are you talking about?"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: player4 puts their ear close to the door and finds it moves slightly; the lock is open.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Try to hide my figure

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Belief arises from desire; if it is what you hope for, it will receive a response. <player4>'s stealth prayer:

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Find a place to hide

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Signal player5 with my eyes to open the door

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: player4 cautiously pushes open the heavy door panel. The scene inside the cave gradually becomes clear in the swaying beam of light. Countless flashlight beams crisscross like wildly dancing silver snakes, illuminating the two sides in the melee. A R'lyeh Cultist's chest splits open, and thick tentacles emerge, coiling a Brotherhood member around the waist and lifting them into the air. The trapped person desperately swings a dagger but cannot pierce the slimy skin. Not far away, another cultist raises a gun and shoots accurately, the bullet hitting a Brotherhood member's chest. However, the gunshot shakes loose stalactites that fall like natural spears from above, instantly piercing the shooter's shoulder. Shouts in Turkish and Italian collide and echo between the rock walls. The smell of blood mixed with gunpowder permeates the damp air.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: OMG
